instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Custom software development house building bespoke ERP, CRM, and workflow automation solutions for mid-market manufacturing and logistics companies. Full-stack team of 22 developers. Evaluating low-code platform adoption to accelerate delivery for standard use cases while preserving custom development for complex integrations. Multi-department organization with formalized budgets, quarterly business reviews, and a dedicated strategy function. We have invested in core systems (ERP, CRM, HRIS) but these are not always well-integrated. Innovation is a standing agenda item at board level with annual investment allocated, but execution velocity varies across business units.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have never run a formal innovation initiative. Problems are solved ad-hoc as they arise, usually by the most directly affected team member. There is no dedicated budget, no structured ideation process, and no track record of experimenting with new technologies or business models beyond basic operational necessity.
answers.strategicGoals: Targeting 30% year-over-year top-line growth. We see untapped demand in adjacent customer segments and are evaluating whether to build, buy, or partner to accelerate market penetration. The core question is whether to deepen our vertical specialization or broaden horizontally into related product categories.
answers.teamSize: Our R&D function consists of 10-12 engineers organized into two squads: one focused on core product innovation and one on exploratory/new business model prototyping. We also have 2 dedicated data engineers building our analytics infrastructure. Innovation projects follow a lean startup methodology with clear go/no-go criteria at 3-month checkpoints.
answers.additionalContext: New data localization requirements in our second-largest market will force us to re-architect our cloud infrastructure within 12 months to maintain operating licenses. This is a non-discretionary technical project that will consume significant engineering capacity. Innovation initiatives must be sequenced around this mandatory work or find ways to turn the migration itself into a modernization opportunity.

input.changes_since_last: Supply chain disruptions affected 5 product lines. Inventory digitalization project launched. Margins under pressure.

opportunities.title: Cloud Infrastructure Modernization for Compliance and Integration
opportunities.rationale: The mandatory data localization requirement forces a massive, non-discretionary technical project. This opportunity must be framed as the catalyst to move beyond isolated system upgrades into a unified, compliant foundational platform. Success here provides the necessary backbone for future growth initiatives.

first_actions: Establish a dedicated Cloud Architecture Review Board (CARB) including legal and compliance representation.
Conduct a gap analysis prioritizing data sovereignty requirements across all 5 product lines affected by supply chain disruption.
Develop a phased migration roadmap that sequences non-mandatory system integrations around core localization work.
resources_needed: Increased budget allocation for cloud services and data governance tools.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 80% of required localized data processing capabilities within the first phase timeline.
milestones: Selection and POC completion of core cloud services in the target market (Month 3).
Pilot migration of one non-critical service into the new architecture.

opportunities.title: Formalizing Market Expansion Portfolio Decisions
opportunities.rationale: The company is evaluating build, buy, or partner options for growth. Currently, this decision varies by project and lacks a formal governing process. Implementing a structured portfolio review will ensure strategic investments align with technical readiness and minimize resources wasted on poorly vetted opportunities.

first_actions: Develop a standardized scoring model that weights required investment (cost/time) against potential market CAGR and internal capability gaps.
Conduct workshops with Business Unit Heads to map out the top 3 adjacent segments for deeper specialization vs. broader expansion.
Assign clear ownership of the portfolio review process to the Strategy Function.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in unprioritized growth proposals by 40% within six months.
milestones: Finalized decision matrix and scoring model (Month 2).
Formal approval of the top two strategic vectors for the next fiscal year (Quarterly review).

next_steps.action: Establish a formal, mandated Platform Governance Board (PGB) to oversee the re-architecture and integration effort. Must include representation from Compliance, Product, and Engineering.
Finalize the scope and MVP criteria for data localization re-architecture. This must be treated as a foundational project, dictating subsequent innovation sequencing.
Implement mandatory Cross-Functional Process Mapping sessions to identify and eliminate manual, ad-hoc processes currently relied upon by specific teams.

key_weaknesses: Lack of unified system integration across core functions (ERP, CRM, Workflow) despite formalizing processes.
Reliance on ad-hoc problem solving rather than structured governance for innovation and crisis management.
Strategic ambiguity regarding market focus (deepening specialization vs. broad horizontal expansion).

improvements: Increased operational structure via dedicated R&D squads and formalized quarterly business reviews.
Successful launch of core digitalization projects, demonstrating internal commitment to process change.
Adoption of structured methodologies (lean startup) for new initiatives.
persistent_gaps: The mandatory technical overhaul required by data localization is currently consuming disproportionate engineering capacity, threatening innovation velocity.
Governance gaps remain in linking strategic growth goals to executable product roadmaps and resource allocation.
Lack of visibility into end-to-end customer journeys due to system silos.
achieved_milestones: Successful mobilization of dedicated data engineering resources for analytics infrastructure buildout.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Increased organizational maturity by establishing formal strategy functions and structured project management (lean startup). However, this progress is currently overshadowed by the mandatory, disruptive technical requirements of data localization compliance.
